tools.name: describe_dataset
tools.description: Start here. What the dataset covers (Connecticut Superior Court motor vehicle personal injury cases, Hartford Judicial District) and how current it is, every field, every stats metric and dimension, caveats, and example calls for each tool.

tools.name: search_cases
tools.description: List auto-injury cases matching filters, in docket-number order, up to 50 per page. Use get_case for one case in full and stats for counts, rates and amounts across many.

tools.name: get_case
tools.description: One case: dates, disposition, trial, verdict and offer amounts, its motion rulings, and the judges, attorneys and law firms by side.

tools.name: stats
tools.description: Compute one metric over cases (or motion rulings), optionally broken down by up to two dimensions and narrowed by filters. describe_dataset lists every metric and dimension and which unit each applies to. Groups of three or fewer cases are suppressed. At most 100 groups, largest first.

tools.name: search_judges
tools.description: List judges by name and district, with case counts, most cases first. get_judge gives one judge in full.

tools.name: get_judge
tools.description: One judge: how the cases they decided ended (closures in the last ~11 months), motion grant rates by motion family, and trial and verdict figures.

tools.name: search_firms
tools.description: List law firms by name, side, district and size, most cases first. get_firm gives one firm in full.

tools.name: get_firm
tools.description: One law firm: its attorneys, the firms it most often faces, the medical experts named for its side, its motion practice, and how its cases ended. A firm's case counts (cases, plaintiffCases, defenseCases) cover every case it appeared in. Its other figures (casesByYear, opposing firms, experts, motio

tools.name: search_attorneys
tools.description: List attorneys by name, firm, side and district, most cases first. get_attorney gives one attorney in full.

tools.name: get_attorney
tools.description: One attorney: their firms, the firms they most often face, the medical experts named for their side, their motion practice, and how their cases ended. An attorney's figures span every firm the attorney has filed with, not only their current firm.

tools.name: search_providers
tools.description: List medical providers named in expert disclosures, by type, specialty, side (treating or defense examiner), town and size, most cases first. get_provider gives one provider in full.

tools.name: get_provider
tools.description: One medical provider: the law firms that named them, their case list, how those cases ended, and, for defense examiners, the kinds of findings they disputed and on which body regions (counts only).

tools.name: request_data
tools.description: Tell us about data this dataset does not have but you need: other courts or states, case types, fields, documents. Logged and read by the people who build the dataset.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message to the person who runs this service: feedback, a question, a problem with the data, or interest in paid features, broader coverage or higher limits. Include the user's name or email only with their explicit permission.
